age_gate.heading: Age verification required
age_gate.body: You must be {age}+ to buy this product. Verify your age with your national eID — we only receive whether you are old enough.
age_gate.body_checkout: This product is for {age}+ only. You'll verify your age with your national eID before checkout.
age_gate.body_cart: Your cart contains products for {age}+ only. Verify your age with your national eID to check out.
age_gate.rejected: You must be {age}+ to buy this product
age_gate.assurance_mitid: Your MitID doesn't have the required security level
age_gate.assurance: Your eID doesn't have the required security level
age_gate.expired: The verification took too long. Please try again.
age_gate.error: The verification didn't work. Please try again.
age_gate.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
age_gate.buy_now_hidden: Add the product to your cart to buy it — express checkout isn't available for age-restricted products.
